episodes.title: Escaping a Cult | Michaelis & Kelani | Episode 100
episodes.description:
In this powerful episode of Against All Odds, Rachel and RJ sit down with Michaelis and Kelani to hear their incredible story of growing up inside a cult and the difficult journey of breaking free.

They share what life was really like behind closed doors, the manipulation and control they experienced, the challenges of leaving everything they had ever known, and how they rebuilt their lives after escaping. Their story is one of courage, resilience, healing, and hope.

This episode offers a rare firsthand look into the realities of cult life and serves as a reminder that freedom and healing are possible, even after unimaginable circumstances.
